sourceText: “I wish the friends were younger,” chuckled Dr. Lanyon. “But I suppose we are. And what of that? I see little of him now.”

attempts.label: primary
attempts.visibleOutput:
TRANSLATION: jan Lanjon pi sona sijelo li toki kepeken kalama musi lili: “mi wile e ni: mi tu jan pona li lili lon tenpo. taso, mi pilin la, mi tu li jan pona ona pi tenpo suli nanpa wan. ni la seme? tenpo ni la mi lukin e ona lon tenpo lili taso.”
NOTES: “younger” is rendered as “lili lon tenpo”; “I suppose” remains uncertain.
